summary: Strawberry Fields REIT, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) disclosing that its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.17 per common share, payable December 30, 2026 to holders of record as of December 16, 2026. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1. No special-situations transaction is involved — no acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, or management change. The dividend is an ordinary capital-return distribution for a NYSE American-listed healthcare REIT. What to watch: sustainability of the quarterly payout against AFFO coverage.
